entries.comment: The Zero Rate applies to newspapers, printed books, e-books, audiobooks, atlases, annual publications, children’s picture, colouring and music books. For a printed booklet to qualify for the zero rating, it must consist of essentially pictorial or textual matter, must have a distinctive front cover devoid of body text, must be no less than eight pages (excluding the cover) and must be bound, stitched or stapled.
